name: api_billing_checkout_session
_description: Fase G - POST crea una Stripe Checkout Session para suscribir al tenant a un plan (starter/pro/equipo). Body: { tier }. Reutiliza stripe_customer_id si ya existe. Trial 14 dias automatico (lo lleva stripe_price). Devuelve { url, session_id } para redirigir al cliente.

parameters.query: SELECT sp.tier_slug, sp.name, sp.price_eur_monthly, sp.stripe_price_id, sp.trial_days, t.contact_email AS tenant_email, t.name AS tenant_name, ts.stripe_customer_id AS existing_customer_id FROM subscription_plans sp CROSS JOIN tenants t LEFT JOIN tenant_subscriptions ts ON ts.tenant_id = t.id WHERE sp.tier_slug = $1::text AND t.id = $2::uuid AND sp.is_active = true LIMIT 1
SELECT key, value FROM system_config WHERE key IN ('stripe_secret_key','billing_success_url','billing_cancel_url')

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details, stripe_code: $json._stripe_code, stripe_type: $json._stripe_type } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { checkout_url: $json.url, session_id: $json.session_id, tier: $('Prepare Checkout').first().json.tier, plan_name: $('Prepare Checkout').first().json.plan_name, status: $json.status, expires_at: $json.expires_at }, meta: { request_id: $('Prepare Checkout').first().json.request_id, provider: 'stripe' } }) }}
